photos.title: Little River waterfront and Mariner's Pointe from above, NAIP aerial, April 2023
photos.what: The Intracoastal Waterway at Little River from straight above on April 10, 2023: the slip basin of Mariner's Pointe, ringed by red-roofed condo buildings, at the lower left; the docks and boats of the waterfront at the end of Mineola Avenue at the right; marsh and long private piers between them; the wide dark waterway across the bottom and woods and marsh on its far bank. Labels: Mariner's Pointe, Waterfront, Intracoastal Waterway.
photos.caption: The waterfront at the end of Mineola Avenue, and the slip basin at Mariner's Pointe, from above.
photos.alt: The Intracoastal Waterway at Little River from above: a slip basin full of boats ringed by condo buildings, labelled Mariner's Pointe, and docks with boats at the end of a street, labelled Waterfront

place.sublocation: The waterfront at Mineola Avenue and Mariner's Pointe, on the Intracoastal Waterway

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (1200 px) and at 600 px by the writer of /submarkets/little-river/ on 2026-11-02. The slip basin with boats at the labelled Mariner's Pointe point is the basin the county's slip parcels sit in; the docks and boats at the Waterfront label are at the south end of Mineola Avenue (county address points). No person, sign, plate or house number is readable at this scale. Review round 1: the 1200x900 cut looked at full size and at 600 px on 2026-11-02; every label is inside the frame and none is in the bottom-right corner where the credit sits. The harbours view has the seam of two NAIP flight lines in the water at the bottom (lighter water on the left); no other 2023 NAIP flight covers it.

photos.title: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village slips from above, NAIP aerial, April 2023
photos.what: One long marina basin off the Intracoastal Waterway in Little River from straight above on April 10, 2023, full of boats in rows of slips: Coquina Harbour's slips in its upper part, Lightkeepers Village's near its mouth. Condo buildings line both sides, US 17 crosses the top left corner, a golf course is at the upper right, and the wide waterway and marsh are across the bottom. Labels: US 17, Coquina Harbour, Lightkeepers Village, Intracoastal Waterway.
photos.caption: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village share one basin between US 17 and the waterway.
photos.alt: A marina basin full of boats off the Intracoastal Waterway, from above, with Coquina Harbour labelled at its upper end, Lightkeepers Village near its mouth, US 17 at the top left and a golf course at the upper right

place.sublocation: Coquina Harbour and Lightkeepers Village, on the Intracoastal Waterway

photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm, flown 2023-04-10 (STAC item sc_m_3307811_ne_17_060_20230410_20230712; datetime 2023-04-10T16:00:00Z).
